en.title: Stray Kids Han Update: August Fashion Vlog and 3RACHA Session
en.summary: Stray Kids' Han checked out outfits and accessories while moving between a store and his accommodations in '[SKZ VLOG] HAN: A Curious Fashion Log,' released on August 18, 2026. The third '3RACHA Session' video, released the next day on August 19, shows Han sitting and talking together with Bang Chan and Changbin.…
